title: frogsdream Mega Pack: Ready-Made Printable Games for $7
metaDescription: Every bingo theme, word search, word scramble and scavenger hunt from frogsdream as ready-to-print PDFs in Letter and A4, with answer keys. One payment of $7.
intro: Everything on this site is free to make and print, and it will stay that way. The Mega Pack is for the times when you would rather not generate anything at all: one download with every theme already laid out as print-ready PDFs, in both US Letter and A4, with answer keys and caller sheets included.

Coming soon

One payment of $7, taxes included. No subscription. Sold through Link, Stripe's merchant of record service.

product.name: frogsdream Mega Pack
product.description: Print-ready PDFs of every frogsdream bingo theme, word search, word scramble and scavenger hunt, plus bedtime and reward charts, in US Letter and A4 with answer keys and caller sheets.

sections.heading: What's inside
body:
* **Themed bingo:** all 51 themed bingo pages from the site, each with **40 unique cards** (5 x 5, or 4 x 4 for the kindergarten themes), printed 2 per page (1 per page for Find Someone Who, so there is room for names), plus a caller checklist for each theme.
* **75-ball bingo:** **100 unique** cards.
* **90-ball UK bingo:** **20 strips of 6 tickets**, where each strip uses every number from 1 to 90 exactly once.
* **Word searches:** all **36** word search themes at **2 difficulty levels** each, every puzzle with its answer key.
* **Word scrambles:** all **10** word scramble themes, each with an answer key.
* **Scavenger hunts:** all **18** scavenger hunt lists.
* **Charts:** **6** bedtime routine and reward chart designs, each in **4 colors**.
* **A one-page Start here sheet** that explains the folders and printing settings.

Every file comes in both **US Letter** and **A4**, as one PDF per theme and paper size, sorted into folders inside a single ZIP download. The PDFs are vector files, so text and lines stay crisp at any print size.

sections.heading: See sample pages
body: These previews are real pages from the pack, shown with a SAMPLE watermark that the downloaded files don't have.

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: The pack suits teachers who want a term's worth of games in one folder, party hosts who would like to print and go, and anyone with a slow connection or a school computer that blocks new websites. If you only need one set of cards for one event, the free generators already do that well, and you don't need the pack.

sections.heading: License
body: Buying the pack gives you a personal license. You may print the files as often as you like for your own home, for your own parties and events, and for **a single classroom** (the classes you teach yourself). You may hand the printed sheets to your students, guests and players.

Please don't resell the files or printouts, upload them to a shared drive or website where others can download them, or pass the ZIP on to other people. If several teachers at a school want to use the pack, each teacher needs their own copy. The full wording is in our [terms](/terms/#mega-pack).

sections.heading: Who sells it, payment and refunds
body: **Who sells it.** The pack is sold through **Stripe Managed Payments**, and the seller of record (the merchant of record) is **Link**, a Stripe company. Your purchase is made with Link, which takes the payment, works out and pays any sales tax or VAT for your country, handles payment questions and disputes, and emails you a receipt. We make the files and help you with them. We never see your card details.
**Price.** $7 in total, including any sales tax or VAT. Checkout may show the amount in your local currency.
**Delivery.** Right after paying, you go straight to a download page for the ZIP file. Bookmark it to download the pack again later.

**Instant download, so no change-of-mind refunds.** The files are yours the moment you pay. When you buy, you ask for immediate access and agree that once the download has started you can no longer cancel the purchase under the 14-day withdrawal right that EU consumer law gives for digital content.
**If a file is faulty.** If a file is damaged, won't open or is missing, email us and we will send you a working copy. If we can't fix it, you get a full refund.
This promise comes on top of your rights under consumer law, which nothing on this page limits. See the [terms](/terms/#mega-pack) for the details and how to make a [complaint](/terms/#complaints).

faq.q: Do I need the Mega Pack to use the generators?
faq.a: No. Every generator on this site is free and makes up to 30 bingo cards, or up to 10 puzzles, each time you press Generate. You can generate as many times as you like. The pack only saves you the generating and gives you more cards per theme in one place.

PDF files inside one ZIP download. Open the ZIP on a computer, then open any PDF and print it like a normal document. Each theme has a Letter file and an A4 file, so pick the one that matches the paper in your printer.

faq.q: Can I change the words in the pack?
faq.a: The PDFs are finished pages and can't be edited. If you want your own words, use the free generator for that theme, which starts with the same list and lets you edit every line.

Because the pack is an instant download, we don't offer refunds if you simply change your mind. If a file is damaged, won't open or is missing, email us and tell us what went wrong. We will send you a working copy, and if we can't fix it, you get a full refund through Stripe.
